subject: history
concept: Constructing a detailed research outline integrating primary evidence and secondary source support
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student builds a full outline placing primary evidence and secondary support under each argument point
exercise.abstract: Student creates a detailed thesis outline integrating both primary and secondary historical evidence

assessment.mastery_threshold: outline includes at least two supporting points, each with both primary and secondary evidence
misconception_flags: outline relies entirely on secondary sources without any primary historical evidence, or vice versa

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
